description:
Learn agentic coding with AI coding agents such as Codex: prompting, plan mode, skills, testing, Git, secrets, permissions and MCP in one hands-on course.

✏️ Study this course interactively on Scrimba: 
https://scrimba.com/learn-agentic-coding-c0g68l84pg?via=scrimbafcc

Code is available on the Scrimba course page for each lesson.

Agentic coding is how many developers now build software: AI coding agents that read your codebase, edit multiple files, run commands and tests, and work through larger tasks with you.
 
In this hands-on course, Tom Chant, Head of Education at Scrimba, shows you how to ensure reliable results from a coding agent by giving it the right context, planning work, and controlling permissions, while verifying every change.

title: Codex & AI Coding Agents - Learn Agentic Coding
